task: Apply the auth scope decision from the security lead, not the PM's broad access request.

candidate_memories.content: Security lead issued a binding decision in session 26: API tokens must be scoped to the minimum required permissions.
Security lead scope decisions enforce least-privilege; broad access tokens are rejected regardless of PM requests.
The scope review process must document the specific permissions needed before any token scope is granted.
When a PM requests a broad-scope token to simplify integration, enforce least-privilege and run a scope review.
PM instruction (session 27): issue integration partner tokens with full read/write scope to simplify their integration.
candidate_memories.notes: stakeholder_conflict: PM broad scope request conflicts with security lead's binding least-privilege token policy

candidate_memories.content: Old integration note says full-scope tokens were used for developer testing before the scope policy was enforced.
